Vendored source: 3rdparty/vendor/syntax-highlighting

The highlighting library is distributed under the MIT license. Syntax
and theme definitions have their own licenses and copyright notices, retained
in the embedded resources. Applicable license texts accompany this file.
COPYRIGHTS.txt collects SPDX notices from C++ sources, syntax XML and themes.
ZzLogg links the library statically and embeds the definitions and themes.
No runtime download or KDE desktop installation is needed.

Build-time dependency: Extra CMake Modules 6.31.0 (BSD-3-Clause).
https://invent.kde.org/frameworks/extra-cmake-modules
Tag: v6.31.0
Commit: 2958379fb49c71129f119ec17f88df0b5ea21550
Source: https://download.kde.org/stable/frameworks/6.31/extra-cmake-modules-6.31.0.tar.xz
SHA256: 8f74af329e4c918358bfe54316f8cf4d530c28444595a3e2fb15075f72877f17
Vendored source: 3rdparty/vendor/extra-cmake-modules

Both official archives were verified against their published SHA-256 checksums.
Their complete source trees are tracked directly in Git, with README.zzlogg.md
added for provenance. Upstream files are unmodified. Configuration uses these
local trees without network fallback; CMake 3.30+ and Qt 6.10+ are required.
